name: website_shop_checkout
summary: Checkout sessions, shipping methods, payment sessions, and online order projection
description: Checkout and order spine on top of the E-Commerce anchor: server-priced checkout sessions with idempotency keys, configurable shipping methods, payment-provider sessions kept separate from order state, and a storefront order projection that references the authoritative Sales order (sale.order). Payment, fulfillment, and return states are tracked independently.
author: Nexa
